2609.24942.title: Exactness at Inference: A Representational Criterion for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
2609.24942.paper_summary: A model generalizes outside its training distribution only when it computes a representation structurally equivalent to the generating mechanism, not an approximation fitted to it. Such equivalence is necessary for exactness in and out of distribution, and extrapolation is governed by this exactness at inference, whatever its realization. Tensor Logic shows this: a zero-temperature contraction is equivalent to discrete logic, deducing in place with no artefact extracted, its tensors Boolean, its embeddings orthonormal, only its arithmetic continuous. Lacking infinite recursion it reaches Datalog, not Prolog, and though exact over closed domains it needs external memory to bind a novel entity. The criterion needs neither a discrete representation nor an extracted expression, and constrains inference, not training: an exact marginal in $[0,1]$ passes, a Neural Network thresholded to a hard label does not. Logic Tensor Networks fail it, while differentiable ILP and Tensor Logic at $T=0$ pass. Piecewise-affine extrapolation divergence and an inability to bind novel entities are two faces of a shortfall in exact representability. For hybrid architectures, a propagation rule follows: the output inherits the bounds of every fitted estimator on its path, explaining which axes fail in equivariant models and the ARC-AGI induction/transduction split. Only an exact hypothesis class certifies what the training data leave underdetermined: on a law-derived partition it finds the $56.3\%$ of distant queries that are answerable, which ensembles meet with false confidence and distance metrics rank backwards. Common inductive biases, from symmetries to memory, reach exactness only because humans inject them, an argument for inducing exact representations rather than fitting surrogates whose residuals, even at the arithmetic floor in training, diverge outside the data and compound under composition.
2609.24942.paper_summary_zh: 模型只有在計算出與生成機制結構上等價的表示時，才能在其訓練分佈之外進行泛化，而不是對其進行擬合的近似。這種等價性對於分佈內外的精確性是必要的，而外推則受此精確性在推理中的支配，無論其實現為何。張量邏輯顯示了這一點：零溫度收縮等價於離散邏輯，無需提取任何工件即可在當地推導，其張量為布爾型，其嵌入為正交正規，只有其算術為連續的。缺乏無限遞歸，它達到的是Datalog，而不是Prolog，儘管在封閉域上是精確的，但它需要外部記憶來綁定新實體。該標準既不需要離散表示，也不需要提取表達，並限制推理，而不是訓練：在$[0,1]$中的精確邊際通過，而閾值為硬標籤的神經網絡則不通過。邏輯張量網絡未能滿足該標準，而可微分的ILP和在$T=0$的張量邏輯則通過。分段仿射外推的發散和無法綁定新實體是精確可表示性不足的兩個方面。對於混合架構，傳播規則遵循：輸出繼承其路徑上每個擬合估計器的界限，解釋哪些軸在等變模型中失敗以及ARC-AGI的歸納/轉導分裂。只有精確的假設類才能證明訓練數據留下的未確定性：在基於法律的劃分上，它找到了$56.3\%$的可回答遠程查詢，而這些集合以虛假的信心相遇，距離度量則向後排名。常見的歸納偏見，從對稱性到記憶，之所以達到精確性，僅僅是因為人類注入了它們，這是一個支持誘導精確表示的論點，而不是擬合殘差的替代品，這些替代品即使在訓練中的算術底線上，也會在數據之外發散並在組合下加劇。
